title: Engineering weekly sync

transcript.speaker: jordan@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Okay, let's start, Raj said he'll join late. Quick round. Mei, you first, because I saw the billing pager going off at 3am.

transcript.speaker: mei@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Yeah, sorry, that was me tuning thresholds. The invoice-generation job alert fires when the nightly run takes longer than 40 minutes. Last night it took 44 because the Postgres vacuum overlapped with it.

transcript.speaker: mei@northwind.dev
transcript.text: I moved the vacuum window to 09:00 UTC and bumped the alert to 55 minutes with a warning at 45. It should stop paging people for something that isn't customer-facing.

transcript.speaker: jordan@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Great. Can you put that in the billing runbook so whoever's on call knows the difference between slow and broken?

transcript.speaker: mei@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Already half written. I'll finish it today.

transcript.speaker: devon@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Me: the session token refresh bug on the Cloud Console is fixed, merged yesterday. I also started reading KeyGate's partner docs because Sam keeps saying the word 'enterprise' at me.

transcript.speaker: jordan@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Ha. That's going to be real soon. Don't build anything yet, just get a feel for their SAML setup.

transcript.speaker: ollie@northwind.dev
transcript.text: I finished the table sorting on the robot list page. Also, um, I may have broken the dark mode toggle in staging. Fixing it.

transcript.speaker: raj@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Sorry, firmware call ran over. Anything blocked?

transcript.speaker: jordan@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Nothing blocked. Mei tamed the billing alerts, Devon closed the token bug, Ollie is learning about dark mode the hard way.

transcript.speaker: raj@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Good. One ask: Mei, can you write up a one-pager on what it would take to get off the legacy billing service? PayStream keeps pitching usage-based billing and I want a real opinion.

transcript.speaker: mei@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Sure. Short answer is proration logic is the scary part. I'll have something by end of next week.

transcript.speaker: jordan@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Last thing, on-call rotation for May is posted. Ollie shadows Devon next week.

transcript.speaker: jordan@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Perfect attitude. That's it, thanks all.

summary: Routine engineering sync. Mei tuned billing service alerts (invoice job warning at 45 min, page at 55 min, vacuum moved to 09:00 UTC) after a false-positive page. Devon merged the Cloud Console session refresh fix and began reviewing KeyGate SAML docs. Ollie shipped robot list sorting. Raj asked Mei for a one-pager on moving off the legacy billing service to PayStream.
decisions: Billing invoice job alert thresholds changed to warn at 45 minutes and page at 55 minutes.

action_items.text: Document the new billing alert thresholds in the billing service runbook
Write a one-pager on migrating from the legacy billing service to PayStream
Fix the dark mode toggle regression in staging
